phd_program: All PhD Programs across 8 UGC-funded Institutions
eligibility: Candidates seeking admission as new full-time PhD students with outstanding academic excellence, research ability, communication skills, and leadership.
tuition_coverage: Varies by host university (fully waived or subsidized by university top-ups)
duration: Up to 3 years (4 years for 4-year PhD programs via university top-up)
dependent_support: Not provided directly by RGC (dependent visas permitted by HK ImmD, but no explicit stipend allowance)
supervisor_requirement: Preliminary supervisor contact recommended before university submission; required at institutional stage
application_requirements: RGC online application form, choice of 2 university programs, academic CV, transcripts, research proposal, 2 referee reports.
source: Research Grants Council (RGC) of Hong Kong

phd_program: PhD in Computer Science / Electrical & Electronic Engineering
eligibility: Top-tier PhD applicants with exceptional academic track record and research achievements.
funding_amount: Up to HK$441,400 in Year 1 (Cash award + PGS + travel subsidy)
tuition_coverage: Full tuition fee waiver of HK$42,100 / year
living_allowance: Cash award of HK$40,000 in Year 1 + monthly PGS of ~HK$18,720 to HK$27,600
dependent_support: No explicit dependent living stipend allowance (health benefits covered on-campus for student)
supervisor_requirement: Strongly advised to identify and obtain preliminary agreement from target supervisor
application_requirements: University online application, research proposal, statement of purpose, 2 academic references, English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS).

university: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
scholarship_name: HKUST RedBird PhD Award & Postgraduate Studentship (PGS)
phd_program: PhD in Computer Science and Engineering / Electronic and Computer Engineering
eligibility: Outstanding doctoral candidates showing high potential for research impact.
funding_amount: HK$40,000 recruitment award + full annual PGS of HK$220,680 (approx HK$18,390/mo)
tuition_coverage: Tuition scholarship available for HKPFS recipients (HK$42,100/yr)
living_allowance: Monthly PGS stipend of HK$18,390 (HK$27,600 if HKPFS awardee)
supervisor_requirement: Highly recommended to engage prospective faculty before formal committee review
application_requirements: HKUST FYTGS application, research proposal, CV, transcript, 2 references, TOEFL/IELTS.
source: HKUST Fok Ying Tung Graduate School

university: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
phd_program: PhD in Information Engineering / Computer Science and Engineering
eligibility: High-caliber students admitted through HKPFS or outstanding departmental nomination.
funding_amount: HK$40,000 - HK$80,000 award + tuition waiver + full studentship
tuition_coverage: Full tuition waiver of HK$42,100 / year for HKPFS recipients
living_allowance: Monthly PGS of HK$18,725 or HKPFS rate of HK$27,600
supervisor_requirement: Mandatory to list prospective supervisor; prior contact strongly recommended
application_requirements: CUHK Graduate School online application, research statement, transcripts, grading scheme, 2 references.

phd_program: PhD in Computing / Electronic and Information Engineering
eligibility: High-achieving PhD candidates with demonstrated research innovation.
funding_amount: Annual cash award of HK$40,000 + full tuition waiver + monthly stipend
living_allowance: Monthly stipend of HK$27,290 (or HK$27,600 for HKPFS)
supervisor_requirement: Target supervisor must support the application for PPPFS nomination
application_requirements: eAdmission portal application, vision statement, academic transcripts, 2 reference letters.

phd_program: PhD in Computer Science / Electrical Engineering
eligibility: Outstanding applicants who demonstrate academic excellence and high research potential.
funding_amount: Monthly scholarship of HK$27,600 (HK$331,200/yr) + travel allowance
supervisor_requirement: Supervisor endorsement required prior to school ranking
application_requirements: CityU SGS application portal, research proposal, CV, TOEFL/IELTS, referee evaluations.
source: CityU Chow Yei Ching School of Graduate Studies

eligibility: Candidates with outstanding academic performance and research promise.
funding_amount: HK$27,600 / month + tuition scholarship + research travel fund
tuition_coverage: Full waiver of tuition fee for HKPFS awardees
supervisor_requirement: Strongly recommended to contact faculty advisor in advance
application_requirements: Online application, proposed topic of research, academic background, 2 referee reports.

phd_program: PhD in Data Science / Computer Science
eligibility: Full-time PhD students with strong academic merit.
funding_amount: Monthly studentship of HK$18,480 (or HK$27,600 for HKPFS awardees)
tuition_coverage: Tuition scholarship available for top-ranked applicants
supervisor_requirement: Applicants should identify a potential supervisor from the School of Data Science
application_requirements: Online application, research outline, certifications, 2 confidential referee reports.

university: The Education University of Hong Kong
phd_program: PhD in Mathematics and Information Technology / Artificial Intelligence
eligibility: Full-time research postgraduate students with solid bachelor's/master's degrees in relevant disciplines.
funding_amount: Monthly studentship of HK$18,200 (or HK$27,600 for HKPFS awardees)
tuition_coverage: Tuition waivers available for distinguished students
supervisor_requirement: Supervisor alignment required during departmental vetting
application_requirements: Online system submission, research plan, academic credentials, 2 referee ratings.
